item: B1: stringfurniture.com the-string-story (String System timeline and owner)

facts.name: String shelf (Nisse and Kajsa Strinning)
facts.fact: Won 1949 Bonniers Folkbibliotek competition; designers Nisse and Kajsa Strinning
facts.quote: Without hesitation, Nisse and Kajsa submitted their design….and won first prize.

facts.name: String milestones
facts.fact: Milan Triennale gold medal 1954; Nationalmuseum permanent collection 1979
facts.quote: 1954 String® was awarded the gold medal at the Milan Triennale.

facts.name: String relaunch
facts.fact: Relaunched Nov 2004 by Peter Erlandsson and Pär Josefsson (page does not name the current owner company)
facts.quote: November 2004, when Peter Erlandsson and Pär Josefsson – two young entrepreneurs and design enthusiasts – tracked down String®’s original creators and convinced them to go back into business.
